text: 9月14日，据国泰海通消息，上海并购私募投资基金三期合伙企业（有限合伙）（简称“上海并购基金三期”）已在中国证券投资基金业协会完成备案，正式开始投资运作。上海并购基金三期首关规模9亿元，由国泰海通私募子公司作为基金管理人，联合大型产业集团、上市公司、金融机构等共同发起设立，主要聚焦高端制造、集成电路、新材料、新能源、信息技术等国家政策支持产业的并购等股权投资机会。
text_en: On September 14, according to Guotai Haitong, Shanghai Mergers and Acquisitions Private Equity Fund Phase III Partnership (Limited Partnership) (abbreviated as "Shanghai M&A Fund Phase III") has completed filing with the Asset Management Association of China and officially began investment operations. The first close of Shanghai M&A Fund Phase III was 900 million yuan, with Guotai Haitong's private equity subsidiary as the fund manager, jointly initiated and established with large industrial groups, listed companies, financial institutions, etc., mainly focusing on merger and acquisition and other equity investment opportunities in industries supported by national policies such as high-end manufacturing, integrated circuits, new materials, new energy, and information technology.
